name: Blossom of Pleasure
source: In this open world, men are the oppressed gender. Without their mistress, they have no free decision making power. However, it is up to you whether this will always be the case. As the chosen one, you must first unfold your powers and decide whether you will lead this world to ruin or usher in a new era.
translation: 在这个开放世界里，男性是受压迫的性别；一旦离开女主人，他们便没有任何自主决定的权利。然而，这种格局是否会永远延续下去，全掌握在你的手中。身为天选之人，你必须率先唤醒自身潜藏的力量，决定究竟是将这个世界引向毁灭，还是开创一个崭新的时代。
